{{Quote|Look upon him. Lord Calypho, the fool.|[[Darth Marr]]|<ref name="The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
'''Lord''' '''Calypho''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of [[Darth Thanaton]]. According to the [[Dark Council]], Calypho overstepped his bounds and sought power he had not earned, causing him to be arrested.

==Biography==
Calypho was kept imprisoned in the [[Dark Council|Council]] [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|headquarters]] in [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. As a test, Calypho's [[Darth Thanaton|apprentice]] was forced to fight against his former Master, defeating him before the eyes of [[Darth Marr]], [[Darth Vowrawn]] and a third Councilor. However, Calypho was spared by the Council for further use. The Council sought to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] Calypho close to death so the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] would experience visions of the future.

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Lord Calypho taught that vision becomes clearest as death draws near.|Darth Marr|<ref name="The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith" />}}
Calypho taught that [[Precognition/Legends|foresight]] grew stronger and clearer as [[Death/Legends|death]] drew near. Through fasting and [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] he sought to achieve clairvoyance.
